method.workload: Current CUDA profile: 512 iterations, seed 0, 49 stones, nine placed, evaluation batch 32, native simulation capacity 32, CPU result workers 4.
method.runs: Sequential fresh processes; first timer-only, then Nsight Systems 2025.3.2 CUDA trace. OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1.
method.capture: cudaProfilerStart/Stop around search only; sample=none, cpuctxsw=none, cuda-graph-trace=graph. Setup/teardown excluded from trace.
method.parity: Both profiled runs exactly match the preceding unprofiled 512-iteration run on the listed fields.
cautions: Native Python-call timers include bindings, host preparation, GPU kernels, transfers, and waits.
CUDA API wall time overlaps GPU activity and must not be added to GPU kernel or copy times.
Per-worker CPU timer totals overlap. Use reward_observation_batch_wall for elapsed result-processing time.
Graph-level tracing aggregates graph execution; activity union includes kernel, graph, copy and memset events without double-counting.
GPU kernel internal memory bandwidth and achieved occupancy are not measured by this trace.
One seed and one frozen nine-stone scene; no universal hardware-throughput claim.

config.yaml:
# Explicit CUDA search profile; select with --config.
# Resolved from stacking-planner agent/configs/ablation.yml and Python defaults.
# Native-only controls and CLI override precedence: docs/excavator-planning.md.
units: si
tree:
  max_depth: 3
  iterations: 512
  max_search_time: 240.0
  max_children: 16
  root_max_children: 32
  exploration_constant: 2.0
  discount: 0.9
  failure_reward: -1.0
  simulation_depth: 5  # Legacy TREE_SIMULATION_DEPTH; absent from ablation.yml.
  initial_depth1_steps: 8  # Depth 1 until 8 objects have been placed.
  root_lookahead: true
widening:
  enabled: true
  coefficient: 3.0
  exponent: 0.5
generation:
  batch_size: 32
  expansion_retry_batches: 3
  min_feasible_children: 3
  attempt_multiplier: 3.0
  evaluation_batch_size: 32
  # Sample the unfilled active floor before higher placements at every depth.
  root_sampling_priority: lower_floor_first
  deeper_sampling_priority: lower_floor_first
validation:
  max_candidates: 8
  root_before_search: true
  rejected_root_retry_rounds: 3
  time_reserve: 30.0
  max_state_drift: 0.1
final_selection:
  mode: max_descendant
  max_weight: 1.0  # Legacy default for mode: max_descendant.
  validate_descendant_path: false
  validate_descendant_depth: 0
  require_validated_descendant: false
parallel:
  posegen_backend: cuda  # cpu or cuda
  simulation_backend: cuda  # cpu or cuda
  # CPU reward/observation workers after batched CUDA simulation.
  enabled: true
  workers: 4
root_cem:
  population: 96
  elite: 24
  iterations: 3
  keep: 32
  mutation_xy_std: 0.1
  mutation_yaw_std_degrees: 5.0
  fresh_fraction: 0.5
  duplicate_xy_threshold: 0.03
  duplicate_yaw_threshold_degrees: 5.0
  # Keep validation slots available for different stones.
  max_per_object: 2
  height_map_score_weight: 1.0
  seed: 0
bootstrap:
  mean_reward: 2.5
  horizon: 4

timers.note: Search-only wall timers; inclusive values overlap. CPU worker times sum overlapping threads and are not search wall time. Exclusive values subtract instrumented child calls on the same thread; native calls include immediate return handling, not pure kernel time.

nsight.command: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 nsys profile --trace=cuda --sample=none --cpuctxsw=none --cuda-graph-trace=graph --capture-range=cudaProfilerApi --capture-range-end=stop --output=/tmp/cuda-search python /tmp/capture.py --backend cuda --seed 0 --config apps/excavator/config/mcts_cuda.yml --state /tmp/state9.pkl --output /tmp/search-nsys.json

conclusions: Host-GPU bandwidth is not the primary bottleneck: 0.2655 seconds of device-side transfers versus 58.57 seconds of kernels.
70,175 eight-byte readbacks take 0.0350 seconds to copy but 26.24 seconds of host API time; 23.82 seconds overlaps device activity, supporting waiting/serialization rather than payload bandwidth.
Native computation is concentrated in the 4D constraint kernel (26.04 s) and posegen force tail kernel (12.93 s).
Outside-native CPU work remains 70.65 s, including 23.42 s reward/observation and 10.60 s floor preparation.
Optimize solver work/parallelism and host result processing; inspect progress polling while preserving convergence semantics. Pinned memory alone cannot remove GPU work or dependent polling.
